title: Nightly ETL
description: Batch ETL from the production Postgres database to the warehouse every night at 2am.

title: Analytics warehouse
description: The analytics warehouse runs on Amazon Redshift.

title: Raw data retention
description: Keep raw event data for 30 days, then delete it.

title: Data catalog
description: Document every warehouse table and its owner in a data catalog.

title: Dashboard access
description: All employees can view all Looker dashboards.

title: Schema change alerts
description: Notify the data team in Slack when an upstream table's schema changes.

title: dbt transformations
description: Transformations are defined as dbt models and run after the nightly ETL.

title: Events table
description: Product events table including user_id, event name, timestamp and customer email address in plain text.

title: Warehouse cost report
description: Weekly report of warehouse spend by team.

title: Data quality checks
description: Row-count checks on core tables after each load.
